subject: Re: Kickoff: LAMP as an interpretable sequential-recs baseline
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing for LAMP:

- Fumiko 50% as research lead through the window; she owns the reproduction and the mixture-weight interpretability analysis.
- Nikhil 30% on the bazel port — the release builds with gflags and plain make, so he'll wrap it rather than rewrite it.
- Yusuf 30% on dataset prep; Brightkite and the other public check-in sets first, then the internal corpus extraction.
- Farah Haddad is committed here at 60% for May 2026 to drive the internal-corpus evaluation and the production-readiness pass — I've confirmed the allocation. Through March/April she's at 20% doing early harness work.

Compute: negligible — this is CPU-bound C++; a couple of 64-core VMs cover every experiment, incl. the max-iter/max-order sweeps the paper recommends starting small on. No cluster asks, which makes a nice change.

Bao
